summary: Iteration 36 — Routing-rules engine wired into /dynamic-route + enterprise_adapters module (9 integrations + Freight Audit ML). 14/14 backend pytest cases PASS (100%). All 18 frontend tabs render. Rules Engine, Adapter Health, Audit ML, Parcel Rater, EDI Gateway, WMS Waves, Live GPS, Dynamic Routing (RECOMMENDED + BLOCKED) all functional end-to-end.
critical_code_review_comments: enterprise_adapters.py is 683 lines — within limit but could be split into per-adapter modules (mileage.py, parcel.py, edi.py, wms.py, dat.py, audit_ml.py) when the file crosses 700.
POST /api/enterprise-tms/dynamic-route requires `pickup_date` — undocumented mandatory field. Consider making optional with today's date as default or document explicitly.

Multiple live-API HTTP clients (FedEx/UPS/PC*Miler/ORS/p44/FourKites/SPS/AutoStore/DAT) lack retry/backoff and circuit-breaker. Fine for mock mode, but production keys will hit transient 5xx. Wrap _get_creds-gated branches with a small tenacity-style retry.
Freight Audit ML samples first 100 anomalies and 25 baselines — make these limits configurable via query params for tenants with large fleets.
EDI 990 ack is queued but never actually transmitted when SPS creds are absent — should expose an outbound queue with retry status visible in /edi/log.
seed_data_creation: Created/deleted 3 transient routing-rules during backend tests (block, prefer_carrier, force_mode) and 1 UI rule (UI_TEST_BLOCK_HAZ_CA) which is still active — main agent may want to delete it via /api/enterprise-tms/routing-rules/{id}.
context_for_next_testing_agent: All adapter endpoints under /api/enterprise-adapters/* are functional with graceful mock fallback. adapter-status returns adapters dict (10 keys), live_count=1 (freight_audit_ml only) until user provides keys. Rule engine: action=block + match_hazmat=true + match_destination_region='CA' produces blocked=true with applied_rules list. Frontend dyn-blocked card + dyn-recommended badge both render correctly. Backend tests verified by repeated run. Note: /api/enterprise-tms/dynamic-route REQUIRES pickup_date.
